__NOTOC__
==Usage==
Place the following code on the page and replace the "mini-game name" with the appropriate information.

 <nowiki>{{</nowiki>TCWA|''MINI-GAME NAME''}}

'''In-Game Locations''': The following code can be used ''instead'' of the above formatting to specify in-game locations within the game.

 <nowiki>{{</nowiki>TCWA|loc=''LOCATION NAME''}}

'''Shop Sets''': The following code can be used ''instead'' of the above formatting to specify buyable sets from the in-game Shop.

 <nowiki>{{</nowiki>TCWA|set=''SHOP SET NAME''}}

'''Card Commander Cards''': The following code can be used ''instead'' of the above formatting to specify cards from the Card Commander mini-game.
 <nowiki>{{</nowiki>TCWA|commcard=''CARD NAME''}}

'''Card Assault Cards''': The following code can be used ''instead'' of the above formatting to specify cards from the Card Assault mini-game.
 <nowiki>{{</nowiki>TCWA|cacard=''CARD NAME''}}

'''Collections''': The following code can be used ''instead'' of the above formatting to specify Collections.
 <nowiki>{{</nowiki>TCWA|coll=''COLLECTION NAME''}}
